description:
PARADOX NOIR — where math gets dark.

Every video is a short journey into the strangest, most forbidden corners of mathematics and physics — the proofs that broke reality, the geniuses who were proven right only after death, the paradoxes that shattered what we thought we knew.

Math. Mystery. Legend.

New drops regularly. Subscribe if you're not afraid of the infinite.
